description: This Java class is a command handler for updating delinquency buckets within the Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and uses the DelinquencyWritePlatformService to perform update operations, annotated with Spring's @Service and @Transactional annotations.

classes.name: UpdateDelinquencyBucketCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands to update delinquency buckets, utilizing DelinquencyWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to update a delinquency bucket by invoking the update method on the write platform service.
